To stabilize the exchange value of the dollar, the Exchange Stabilization Fund (ESF) was established pursuant to chapter 6, section 10 of the Gold Reserve Act of January 30, 1934 (codified at 31 United States Code 5302), which authorized establishment of a Treasury fund to be operated under the exclusive control of the Secretary, with approval of the President.

python3 -c "
import re

# Read 2011 bulletin (for Sept 2010)
with open('/app/resources/treasury_bulletin_2011_03.txt', 'r') as f:
    content_2011 = f.read()

# Read 2012 bulletin (for Sept 2011)
with open('/app/resources/treasury_bulletin_2012_03.txt', 'r') as f:
    content_2012 = f.read()

# Read 2013 bulletin (for Sept 2012)
with open('/app/resources/treasury_bulletin_2013_03.txt', 'r') as f:
    content_2013 = f.read()

# Extract total assets for each year
# Look for the line with 'Total assets' and get the last column (Sept value)
for name, content in [('2011 (Sept 2010)', content_2011), 
                       ('2012 (Sept 2011)', content_2012),
                       ('2013 (Sept 2012)', content_2013)]:
    # Find lines with Total assets
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        if 'Total assets' in line and '|' in line:
            parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split('|') if p.strip()]
            if parts[0] == 'Total assets' and len(parts) >= 2:
                # Last column is the September value
                sept_value = parts[-1]
                if sept_value.isdigit():
                    print(f'{name}: {int(sept_value):,}')
"
